title: Jordan H NDE 13066
content: I drank some alcohol, took a couple of pills and bought another pill from my friend. When I snorted, pill I'd bought, I sat back and within minutes blacked out. I didn't know there was fentanyl in the pill. My dad came in my room and found me not breathing. He called 911 and laid me on my back in the living room. He started giving me CPR. I remember my entire life flashing before my eyes. Then, a Being took me to a garden. It was the most peaceful feeling I’ve ever felt; no depression, no anxiety, no worries. I felt just peace. The next thing I know, I'm standing over my body that’s being revived by firefighters. I was with the Being of light. It seemed feminine and almost like she'd had the presence of everyone I ever loved inside them. Every question I had, was answered telepathically. The Being told me, 'Everything is going to be okay' and 'It wasn’t my time yet.' Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: 10/10/2020 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes. Drug or medication overdose. Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function) How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I watched my body being revived. I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal. I just felt so at peace, like nothing was or ever was wrong At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? When I was standing next to my body with the being of light Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Time seemed to go faster or slower than usual. It happened so fast but felt like I was with that Being for hours Were your senses More vivid than usual? Incredibly more vivid Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. In the garden or going through the tunnel, things looked so vivid Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I didn’t hear anything Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Yes To get shown my life and to the garden Did you see any beings in your experience? I sensed their presence Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes I felt the presence of my ex who hung herself, and my previously deceased grandpa and granny Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes It was in the shape of a human but just a being of light Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm. It was almost like an empty field or garden with flowers everywhere What emotions did you feel during the experience? Peacefulness Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Happiness Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt united or one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about myself or others. I understood my loved ones that have already passed over are okay Did scenes from your past come back to you? My past flashed before me, out of my control. I saw my whole life in seconds Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? I grew up with a Catholic/Christian grandma but I doubt the religion Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Uncertain. I don’t understand it, but know that there is a better place What is your religion now? Do not know. There is life after death Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I know there is more after this life on earth Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin. I heard the Being talk even though they had no mouth Did you see deceased or religious spirits? I sensed their presence Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? Yes After we die, I feel like we are all together - where ever that is. During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Yes The Being of light Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? Yes They just told me that I still had stuff to do and that it wasn’t my time During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? Yes I knew there’s a place we go when we die, our lives are not over Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? Yes I felt love from the Being and just knowing my passed-on family is okay What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Large changes in my life After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes It’s hard to describe in words How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? Knowing my loved ones are okay and that this life isn’t the end Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes Right after. They didn’t know what to think Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No g9o32e4_nde

arrival.other_being_detail: A feminine-presenting being of light; also sensed presence of deceased loved ones (ex, grandpa, granny).

environment.environment_other_detail: Described as an empty field or garden with flowers everywhere; very vivid.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Told he still had "stuff to do" and that it wasn’t his time yet.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Drug/medication overdose (pill contained fentanyl) with cessation of breathing; CPR by father and revival by firefighters.

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Grew up with Catholic/Christian grandmother; doubted religion at the time.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Life flashed before his eyes, then a being took him through a tunnel to a garden; later he was standing over/next to his body as firefighters revived it, with the being of light.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: The being of light felt feminine and as if it had the presence of everyone he ever loved inside it.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "Everything is going to be okay"; "It wasn’t my time yet."
